crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
Salvation belongs to Yahweh. May your blessing be on your people.
Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
He will bless those who fear Yahweh, both small and great.
Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in Yahweh.
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk…

translations.web: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.
translations.bsb: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
translations.kjv: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
translations.asv: For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield. Psalm 6 For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, set to the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
